configuration_boundary.model_range_facts: Arm defaults use -2π..2π unless a joint-specific range is declared; joint2, joint4, joint6 and gripper driver ranges are explicitly declared in the Menagerie MJCF. Gripper follower motion is coupled by tendon/equality constraints.

source_registry.facts: Seven arm joints, six gripper joints, link_tcp site, seven arm position actuators plus gripper tendon actuator, and home keyframe.

source_status: PUBLIC_REFERENCE_ONLY; MJCF and assets intentionally not vendored in this preparation package

tasks.description: Move the xArm7 TCP reference to the specified reachable 3-D target and stop.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Single Cartesian reach using the seven-joint serial arm; the gripper is not required.
tasks.criterion_summary: TCP target error is at most 50 mm for 0.5 s; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Trace a small square in Cartesian space with the xArm7 TCP reference and return to start.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable G2 path-tracing primitive over the xArm7 serial chain.
tasks.criterion_summary: Maximum waypoint and return errors are at most 50 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move the xArm7 TCP reference by the specified Cartesian offset, hold, and return.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable bounded offset effect independent of gripper use.
tasks.criterion_summary: Offset and return errors are at most 50 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Visit the specified ordered Cartesian waypoints with the xArm7 TCP reference.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Reusable ordered waypoint primitive for a serial arm with an explicit TCP site.
tasks.criterion_summary: Every waypoint is within 60 mm and order is preserved; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.

tasks.description: Move the xArm7 TCP reference to one reachable waypoint and return to the reset pose.
tasks.difficulty_rationale: Minimal two-leg serial-arm primitive that exercises return behavior.
tasks.criterion_summary: Waypoint and final return errors are at most 50 mm; threshold is an experimental conservative choice.
